name: item
useFor: Use for lists of things a reader scans and acts on: merchants, orders, agents, files. Group rows in ItemGroup with ItemSeparator between them. Use asChild with a link to make a row navigate; mark the current row with aria-current.
constraints: Two primary keys in one row
Rows with no rule or card between them in a long list
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (monitoring.tsx rows, in-action.tsx step list, card.tsx)
